A sleek '''black-and-gold Z-95 Headhunter''' was one of six purchased by [[Flight Captain]] [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] for the pilots of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] in the weeks proceeding the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|Liberation of Coruscant]]. Of the six, this particular Z-95 Headhunter was flown by Tycho as he considered it to be the best one he could buy and used it to cover members of Rogue Squadron during their initial guerrilla operations on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] Captain later transferred ownership of the starfighter to his squadmate, [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]], during a stratospheric skirmish above Coruscant’s cityscape; during which Corran used the callsign ‘[[Hunter Lead]]’ as he [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] the Z-95 Headhunter.

==History==
Tycho Celchu's [[Color/Legends|black-and-gold]] Z-95 Headhunter was purchased by the Tycho in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]] from [[Lai Nootka]] after he had been secretly ordered by [[Rogue Leader/Legends|Rogue Leader]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] to scrounge up weapons and starfighters for the other members of Rogue Squadron. This was part of Rogue Squadron's pre-mission prep to use once they had devised a plan to knock out Coruscant's [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shielding]]. Tycho used this Z-95 Headhunter to provide air support after the members of Rogue Squadron and their [[Alien Combine]] allies had been ambushed by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] and needed a quick evac. Later, Tycho personally offered this Z-95 Headhunter to Corran Horn, telling the pilot that it was the best fighter they had at their disposal and that there was no one else in the squad Tycho trusted to bring the fighter back safely.<ref name="WG" />
[[File:HunterSquadron-TERC.jpg|thumb|left|83px|Tycho Celchu's Z-95 Headhunter (uppermost)]]
With [[Pash Cracken/Legends|Pash Cracken]] as his [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmate]], Corran Horn flew the Z-95 Headhunter as he led the five-pilot ersatz [[Hunter Squadron (New Republic)|Hunter Squadron]] through the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|vast cityscape]] of Coruscant to protect a hijacked [[EVS Construction Droid|EVS Construction droid]] controlled by Wedge Antilles and [[Winter Celchu|Winter]]. By the end of the skirmish, Corran Horn had shot down four [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/ln Fighters]] and one [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Interceptor]] with the fighter. Yet at the battle's conclusion, the Z-97 Headhunter's [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]] suddenly suffered a severe malfunction and crashed on Coruscant's surface, leading Corran Horn to be presumed dead.<ref name="WG" /> Unbeknownst to both Tycho and Corran, their squadmate and secret [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]], [[Erisi Dlarit]], had sabotaged the fighter's navigation computer just prior to Tycho handing ownership over to Corran. This was part of a scheme formulated by [[Ysanne Isard]] to frame Tycho as a spy who conspired to murder Corran Horn.<ref name="TKT">''[[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap]]''</ref>

==Characteristics==
Tycho Celchu's Z-95 Headhunter was distinct from the standard model because of it's custom sleek black-and-gold plating. It was also noted by Tycho as being the best Headhunter he was able to acquire, meaning it at least functioned better than a standard second-hand Z-95 Headhunter - though the extent of its apparent superiority was not expanded upon.<ref name="WG" />
